Employers nationwide rely on Asure for payroll & HR.

Run payroll and HR the way your business needs.
Some employers prefer to manage payroll and HR internally. Others choose expert help because they don't have the time, staff, or expertise to manage it confidently.
Asure supports both approaches in one environment. Run payroll yourself using our platform or rely on Asure's experts to handle the work.
Run payroll and HR yourself
Use the AsureCentral platform to process payroll, manage employee records, track time, administer benefits, and give employees self-service access to their information.
Have Asure experts manage payroll and HR
AsureWorks provides managed payroll and HR services delivered by Asure specialists who handle the operational work for you.
Payroll and HR operations managed for you.

Payroll, tax filings, HR compliance, and benefits administration are complex and constantly changing. AsureWorks provides a team of specialists who run these operations for you — handling the day-to-day execution so your team can stay focused on running the business.
Payroll, HR, compliance, and benefits managed together by one operational partner.
Asure specialists handle the operational execution behind payroll and workforce administration.
Reduce the internal time, coordination, and administrative pressure of workforce operations.
The platform behind payroll and HR operations.

AsureCentral powers payroll, HR, benefits, and workforce management for employers. Whether you run payroll internally or rely on AsureWorks to manage the work for you, everything operates through one connected system designed for businesses managing employees.
Luna AI is built into how Asure works
Luna is an embedded AI assistant across AsureCentral that helps employers, managers, and employees get answers, surface what matters, and keep payroll and HR moving without interruption.

It works across the entire employee experience—from answering employee questions to helping managers take action to keeping payroll and HR operations on track—so work gets done faster, with fewer errors, and less back-and-forth.
Payroll, HR, and benefits in one system.
Everything you need to run payroll, manage employees, administer benefits, and stay compliant — all in one platform.
Payroll processing and HR management
Employees manage their own data
HR expertise and compliance support
Payroll and HR support at every level of complexity.

Payroll and HR don't get harder just because your business is growing — they get harder as your workforce, hiring, compliance requirements, and tax obligations become more complex. Asure supports employers through every stage of that complexity.
Run payroll accurately, pay employees on time, and stay compliant with basic requirements.
Handle multi-state employees, changing regulations, and expanding HR responsibilities with confidence.
Complex payroll and tax requirements
Manage filings, funding, and compliance across more demanding payroll and tax environments.
What you get when payroll and HR are done right.
Payroll runs. Employees are paid correctly. Taxes are filed on time. Compliance is handled. You don't have to check it, fix it, or think about it.
That's what it means to have payroll and HR done right — a system you can rely on and outcomes you can trust.
Payroll you can rely on
Employees are paid accurately and on time
Stay ahead of payroll taxes and employment laws
More time for the business
Spend less time on administration and more time running your company
Understand what's actually breaking in your payroll and HR.
What worked before stops working as your business becomes more complex — but no one tells you when or why.
The Employer Growth Standard helps you name the friction you're feeling, identify your current stage, and understand what "good" looks like — so you know what needs to change next.
Let's get your payroll and HR set up the right way.
Whether you want to run payroll yourself or have experts manage it for you, Asure can help you build the right approach for your business.

raw_blocks: Asure helps businesses develop Human Capital to get to the next level, stay compliant, and allocate their time, money and technology toward growth.
Asure’s leadership and dedication has enabled the company to help more than 100,000 growing businesses stay compliant, pay employees, and get the most from their Human Capital.
NASDAQ: ASUR Austin, TX Payroll & HR Solutions
HCM Through the Lens of Entrepreneurs

Asure sees Human Capital Management through the lens of entrepreneurs and executives with an owner’s mentality. We understand that business owners need to build great teams—but must also allocate financial capital in areas that drive growth, not bloated back-office functions.

With headquarters in Austin, TX and offices throughout the United States, Asure provides HCM software and services in every state and territory. We build great HCM software that’s delivered via the cloud on a subscription basis—so it doesn’t require any IT overhead or a large capital purchase.
Be the most trusted Human Capital Management resource to entrepreneurs everywhere.
Provide Human Capital Management software and services that help companies grow, while nurturing a culture of growth around us.
Nurturing Growth in Everything We Do
Our mission isn’t just about software. It’s about creating a culture of growth that extends to our customers, our employees, our communities, and our shareholders.
Help customers grow by getting the most from their human capital.
Help our employees grow personally and professionally.
Grow relationships in our communities that inspire goodness.
Do all of these things in a way that grows shareholder value.
“Effective leadership means ensuring that transformation permeates every level of the company, not just the top.”
What Guides Us Every Day
Our core values shape how we build products, serve customers, and support each other. They aren’t just words on a wall—they’re how we operate.
Embrace Change Adaptability and forward-thinking in everything we build.
Lead with Integrity Ethical conduct, transparency, and trust at every level.
Own the Outcome Accountability and results-driven dedication.
Deliver Awesome Excellence through continuous improvement.
Be a Good Human Kindness, respect, and care in everything we do.
Asure’s leadership team brings decades of experience in human capital management, technology, and building solutions that help businesses grow.
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

Pat Goepel leads Asure’s strategy and growth, focusing on building a platform that helps businesses manage payroll, HR, and compliance with confidence. He has spent his career scaling technology-enabled service companies and driving operational discipline, predictable revenue growth, and long-term value creation. Under his leadership, Asure has expanded its capabilities across payroll, HR, and financial services while strengthening the infrastructure required to support businesses at scale.
Brings 30+ years of experience in HR, payroll, and outsourcing, with prior leadership roles at Fidelity Investments, Advantec, and Ceridian.
President and Chief Revenue Officer

Eyal Goldstein leads revenue strategy, go-to-market execution, and key operating functions across Asure’s growth-focused business lines. In addition to overseeing sales and marketing, he is responsible for scaling several of Asure’s fastest-growing product areas, aligning revenue generation with service delivery and operational performance. He brings deep experience building high-performing organizations and driving growth in competitive markets.
Has over 20 years of experience in enterprise software and HCM, with prior leadership roles at Oracle, Ceridian, and ADP.

John Pence oversees Asure’s financial strategy, reporting, and capital management. In addition to financial leadership and public company governance, he is responsible for the financial infrastructure that underpins payroll funding, tax payments, and compliant client money movement at scale. His focus is on maintaining financial discipline while optimizing liquidity, managing risk, and ensuring efficient handling of funds across the platform.
Offers 20+ years of experience across finance, technology, and benefits, with prior leadership roles at Beneplace, Mobi, Freescale Semiconductor, and Arthur Andersen.

Yasmine Rodriguez leads technology strategy, platform development, and AI innovation at Asure. She is responsible for advancing AsureCentral and Luna AI while unifying product, data, and infrastructure into a scalable, integrated platform. With deep expertise in payroll tax and compliance systems, she plays a critical role in strengthening Asure’s system of record and the underlying compliance infrastructure that powers payroll and HR operations at scale.
Brings 20+ years of experience in HCM technology and payroll tax systems, with prior leadership roles at ADP and OneSource Virtual.

Mike Vannoy leads marketing strategy, demand generation, and brand development at Asure. He brings nearly three decades of experience across payroll, HR, and human capital management, spanning sales, marketing, and agency leadership. At Asure, he focuses on aligning go-to-market strategy with customer needs and driving pipeline growth across the platform.
Brings 25+ years of experience in payroll, HR, and human capital management, with prior leadership roles at Ceridian, Sales Engine Media, and Simplex Time Recorder.
Senior Vice President, Asure Pay and Marketplace

Jay Whitehead leads Asure’s AsurePay and marketplace initiatives, expanding financial services and partner-driven capabilities on the platform. He brings experience in payments, partnerships, and product commercialization, with a focus on creating flexible solutions that enhance payroll without adding complexity.
Brings 20+ years of experience across HR, payments, and workforce solutions, with prior leadership roles at Ultimate Software, TriNet, PeopleDoc, and HRO Today.

Mike Eralie leads operational execution across Asure’s service delivery and customer support functions. He is responsible for ensuring payroll, HR, and compliance processes are delivered accurately and consistently at scale. His focus is on operational excellence, service quality, and delivering a consistently strong experience for customers across every interaction.
Brings 20+ years of experience in payroll and HR operations, with prior leadership roles at Safeguard Global and NGA.
Ready to Grow with Asure?
See how Asure’s payroll and HR solutions can help your business stay compliant, pay employees, and get the most from your Human Capital.
